what: Khách sạn Hải Âu (124 Hạ Long), in front of the jetty of Cầu Đá: sky blue walls with white bands, a middle block of six storeys under a canopy with the red letters HAI AU, a stair tower of glass, a north wing of five storeys and a south wing of five storeys with a glazed second storey and its top storeys set back

options.name: khach_san_hai_au
sources: Khách sạn Hải Âu (124 Hạ Long), Vũng Tàu, as in 2019 (report 0026, Q7 and Q8). Plan: OpenStreetMap way 790529523 (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL). Look: photos of 2014 (trungydang, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0), 2010 (HappyMidnight, CC BY-SA 4.0) and of 2019 or before (Viet Fun Travel).

sources.author: trungydang
sources.shows: From the far side of Hạ Long, to the east: sky blue walls with white bands; the north wing (left) of 5 storeys with bands of balconies and round balconies at its north end; the middle block of 6 storeys with balconies under a curved canopy with the red letters HAI AU; the stair tower of glass right of it; the south wing of 5 storeys: a white band, a glazed second storey, and the third and fourth storeys set back behind terraces; shops and a porch at the ground storey.

sources.date: on or before 2019-01-18 (the date of the image file on the server)
sources.author: Viet Fun Travel
sources.shows: Near the porch, up: the same light blue walls with white bands, the middle block with its balconies one over the other and the canopy with the big red letters HAI AU and the round logo on the roof, the stair tower of glass, the glazed second storey of the south wing in white frames, the terrace of its third storey with a rail, the arches of the porch on the ground storey.

sources.author: HappyMidnight
sources.shows: From the jetty of Cầu Đá, to the east: the same blocks, white with light green panels in 2010, white letters HAI AU on the canopy of the middle block; the north wing with long balconies, the stepped south wing.

length.source: The outline of OpenStreetMap (way 790529523; © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL): 71.7 m along Hạ Long, from its south corner to its north end.

depth.source: The outline of OpenStreetMap (way 790529523), simplified: the north wing 14 to 16 m, the middle block 17 m, the south wing 16 m. The outline has a notch of 12 m by 9 m in front of the stair tower; photos 0 (2014) and 1 (2019 or before) show the front of the south wing up to the stair tower, so the front of the south wing goes on to it.

storeys_middle.source: Photo 0 (2014): the ground storey and five storeys over it under the canopy (counted); photo 1 shows the same balconies one over the other.

storeys_wings.source: Photo 0 (2014): the north wing and the south wing have the ground storey and four storeys over it (counted).

storey.source: estimate (no source): no person or car is at the face of the building in a photo; 3.3 m is the storey of the stand-ins.

ground_storey.source: estimate (no source): the shops and the porch of the ground storey are high in photo 0; a band of 0.6 m over it.

height.value: 18.1 m (wings), 21.4 m (middle block), 22.5 m (canopy), 24.6 m (top of the letters)
height.source: From the storeys, the storey and the parapet of 1.0 m (estimate (no source)); the spec gave 22 m for the middle block with its canopy.

canopy.value: 14.8 m wide, 5.2 m deep, rises 10 degrees to the front, a white edge 1.9 m in front of the middle block
canopy.source: Photo 0 (2014): a curved canopy over the middle block, a little wider than its front; photo 1 (2019 or before): its blue underside and its white edge. The sizes are estimates (no source).

letters.value: HAI AU, red #c7262c, 2.1 m high and 5.8 m long, on the canopy a little north of its middle
letters.source: Photo 0 (2014), as measured in the spec: the letters are 0.63 of a storey high (2.1 m) and 1.75 storeys long (5.8 m). Q8: the letters go on the model. The letters of the building blueprint are wider than these, so they are tubes in more.chu with their own width (see the report).

stair_tower.value: 3.4 m by 3.6 m, 22 m high, panes of light glass in white frames
stair_tower.source: Photo 0 (2014): a narrow tower of glass between the middle block and the south wing, as high as the canopy; photo 1 (2019 or before) the same. The plan sizes are estimates (no source).

south_wing.value: a white band at the second floor, a glazed second storey (dark glass, white frames every 1.25 m), the third storey set back 2.4 m behind a terrace with a white rail, the fourth storey set back 4.6 m
south_wing.source: Photo 0 (2014) and photo 1 (2019 or before): the glazed band and the terrace with its rail. The depths of the set-backs are estimates (no source).

bands.value: white bands of balconies at each floor of the north wing (1.0 m out) and of the middle block (1.4 m out); three round balconies at the north end
bands.source: Photo 0 (2014): the white bands at each floor and the round balconies at the north end of the north wing; photo 2 (2010) shows the same balconies.

colors.source: Q7: the look of photo 0 (2014). In the spec, the median of the sunlit wall of the middle block is #73a2d0 and the south wing in the sun #83b6e7: #78a8d8 between them. Photo 1 (2019 or before) shows the same light blue with white trim.

windows.value: 5, 3 and 6 windows a storey on the fronts of the north wing, the middle block and the south wing; the windows of the ends and of the back
windows.source: estimate (no source) of the counts; photo 0 shows wide windows with curtains behind the bands.

looks.seen: A preview in my workspace, not a build of the factory: the factory answers HTTP 503 (memory) when it places this order, so I made the edits of the rule (World.Town.Building, ported to Python) into voxels of 0.15 m and rendered them with tools/world/look.gd (build/look/khach_san_hai_au_preview_mid.png). Next to photo 0 (2014): the north wing with its white bands, the middle block with HAI AU on its canopy, the south wing with its glazed second storey and its set-backs agree; but the stair tower did not show, because the cuts of the set-backs of the south wing took its top away.
looks.changed: The set-backs and the glazed band of the south wing start south of the stair tower; the stair tower is 1.4 m higher, as high as the frame behind the letters in photo 0.

looks.seen: A preview in my workspace, not a build of the factory: the factory answers HTTP 503 (memory) when it places this order, so I made the edits of the rule (World.Town.Building, ported to Python) into voxels of 0.15 m and rendered them with tools/world/look.gd (build/look/khach_san_hai_au_preview_mid.png). Next to photos 0 (2014), 1 (2019 or before) and 2 (2010): the order of the blocks from north to south, the stair tower of glass over the roofs next to the canopy, the red letters HAI AU readable from the street, the light blue walls with white bands, the glazed storey and the terraces of the south wing. Still different: the balconies of the middle block are straight bands (curved and stepped in the photos), the canopy is a flat slab (curved), no porch with arches at the ground storey, no masts on the roof, and the sign of the bank on the roof of the north wing is left out on purpose (a brand).

A preview in my workspace, not a build of the factory: the factory answers HTTP 503 (memory) when it places this order, so I made the edits of the rule (World.Town.Building, ported to Python) into voxels of 0.12 m and rendered them with tools/world/look.gd (build/look/khach_san_hai_au_preview_near.png). As at the mid level.

uses: Plan 0026, R7, Q7, Q8: on its OSM outline (way 790529523) by Hạ Long, in place of its stand-in (6 storeys, stand_ins.storeys of data/showcase/bai_truoc.json); PT-74 takes a screenshot of it; its place is in data/world/places/bai_truoc.json.
